git_scope: Blobless clone of evand/square-packing and a sparse checkout of 0075967 (committed 2026-10-20T02:36:12Z), the commit that refreshes the regularized record lists at 183, 204, 227, 229, 260 and 308; no issue asked. Retained: the certificates and JSON of the four counts whose sides lie below every value the record held or had pending when read (204, 227, 229 and 260), each as its original gzip, with the method log REGULARIZE.md, the licence and the credits. The eight files are byte-identical at the branch head 88385ab, the head on 21 October. The two exact checkers the certificates name are pinned by digest against the identical copies the n183 packet retains; refresh.py and samepacking.py, the best-choice lists best.csv and best.json, and the site's record provenance records2026.json and lineage.yaml by digest only. The same commit's 183 and 308 certificates state T-220's and T-221's sides and are not retained; the rest of the tree is pinned by the commit and was not retained or executed.

claims: search/regularize/lists/certs/n-NNN.cert.gz holds the exact rational certificate of the display-regularized view of the source store's best packing at each count; at the four counts retained here the certificates state s(204) <= 14808642840591493923068442871459/10^30 = 14.808642840591493923068442871459, s(227) <= 7781812826162574542396221861851/(5*10^29) = 15.563625652325149084792443723702, s(229) <= 15650161513876431064009548865321/10^30 = 15.650161513876431064009548865321 and s(260) <= 4161438312629953048686574163329/(2.5*10^29) = 16.645753250519812194746296653316, each the S_cert its JSON states and the header side of its certificate.

The commit message says the six refreshed counts were 'certified and regularized', that the records at 204, 227 and 260 are Francisco Couzo's and at 229 Evan Daniel's, and of 229 'after the slp2 polish, 2e-11 below the posted float: the exact optimum of the same packing'. Each JSON names the packing's finder under 'by' (Francisco Couzo at 204, 227 and 260; Evan Daniel at 229) and says 'regularized display view of a certified packing at the same side; not a new bound'.

Each JSON reports the certificate VALID (cert_valid) and verified at 80 digits, the conservative policy, and level 2, 'same packing: traversable without expansion (angle moves path-checked; slides by construction)', by the method log's sampled path test, which it says is not a continuous proof. Its angle changes at the four counts are free angles kept, none turned or merged.
